description: This file defines functions to create and serialize different types of USP (Universal Service Platform) records, including WebSocket, MQTT, STOMP, UDS connect, and disconnect records. It uses Protocol Buffers for serialization and manages memory allocation for message buffers.

methods.name: void USPREC_WebSocketConnect_Create(char * cont_endpoint_id,mtp_send_item_t * msi)
methods.description: Creates a WebSocket Connect record, serializes it to protobuf, and initializes an MTP send item with the serialized buffer.

methods.name: void USPREC_MqttConnect_Create(char * cont_endpoint_id,mqtt_protocolver_t mqtt_version,char * agent_topic,mtp_send_item_t * msi)
methods.description: Creates an MQTT Connect record with specified protocol version and topic, serializes it, and prepares it for transmission.

methods.name: void USPREC_StompConnect_Create(char * cont_endpoint_id,char * destination,mtp_send_item_t * msi)
methods.description: Creates a STOMP Connect record with a destination, serializes, and prepares it for sending.

methods.name: void USPREC_UdsConnect_Create(char * cont_endpoint_id,mtp_send_item_t * msi)
methods.description: Creates a UDS Connect record, serializes, and prepares it for transmission.

methods.name: void USPREC_Disconnect_Create(mtp_content_type_t content_type,char * cont_endpoint_id,uint32_t reason_code,char * reason_str,mtp_send_item_t * msi)
methods.description: Creates a disconnect record with reason and code, serializes, and prepares it for sending.
